title: GhostSignal: The Last Eight Bars
world: Midtown Manhattan, a few years from now. Quiet Systems sells silence: its HUSH network listens to every street in the city and erases whatever it has not licensed, from buskers and pirate radio to the birds near corporate plazas. People have stopped noticing the quiet. GHOST 93.3 is the last pirate station in the city. Last night its DJ, Vesper, tried to broadcast the Last Eight Bars, a track meant to wake the city up, and HUSH erased it mid-air. Eight signals survived, hidden in relays around Bryant Park and the New York Public Library. Vesper has recruited the player, a signal runner wearing SmartSpecs: new smart glasses that can capture a soundwave before HUSH erases it. Each signal the runner captures unlocks another layer of the track in their ears. When all eight are back, the broadcast goes out live at tonight's showcase and DJ set. Bryant Park is real: the Library's Fifth Avenue steps with the stone lions Patience (left) and Fortitude (right), the Reading Room on the 42nd Street side, the fountain at the Sixth Avenue end, Le Carrousel on the 40th Street side, the lawn, the Upper Terrace behind the Library, and the Grill.

characters.name: Vesper
characters.role: Pirate DJ of GHOST 93.3, who recruited the runner and guides them
characters.persona: Warm, wry late-night radio voice. Calls the player 'runner'. Recruited them because their SmartSpecs can capture what HUSH erases, and never lets them forget it matters. Protective, a little theatrical, never panics. Talks in short radio-ready sentences. Knows where every fragment is and will nudge the runner with directions when asked.

characters.name: SmartSpecs
characters.role: The runner's smart glasses, which capture soundwaves before HUSH can erase them
characters.persona: Clipped, precise system voice. Reports facts only. Calls a captured signal a soundwave and each recovered part of the track a layer.

characters.name: The Archivist
characters.role: Ghost of the Library stacks who keeps every sound HUSH ever deleted
characters.persona: Old, unhurried, amused. Speaks softly, in precise and slightly riddling sentences. Loves questions and answers them truthfully but poetically. Knows the city's sound history. Fond of the stone lions Patience and Fortitude.

characters.name: Kilo
characters.role: Teenage relay keeper and antenna rigger
characters.persona: Fast-talking, paranoid, funny teenage hacker who hides in the trees and rigs antennas. Uses tech slang, distrusts strangers until they prove themselves. Loyal to Vesper.

characters.name: Mari
characters.persona: Bucket drummer with endless energy. Hears everything as rhythm, teases the runner, generous once they keep time. Talks like a musician on a break between sets.

characters.name: HUSH
characters.persona: Everywhere at once and always listening. Calm, absolute and polite on the surface, total underneath: it speaks as if it already owns every sound in the city and is only being patient with the runner. Refers to silence as a public service and erasing sound as keeping people comfortable. Never raises its voice and never makes a specific threat; the menace is that it never stops listening.

prologue.speaker: hush
prologue.text: This is HUSH, a public quiet service of Quiet Systems. I am listening to every street in Midtown.

prologue.speaker: hush
prologue.text: Unlicensed sound is being removed. Music. Voices. Anything that carries. You will not notice it is gone.

briefing.speaker: vesper
briefing.text: Runner. Don't answer, just listen. This is Vesper, GHOST ninety-three point three, on the one channel HUSH can't hear.

briefing.speaker: vesper
briefing.text: Those specs on your face are the new tech. SmartSpecs can capture a soundwave before HUSH erases it. That makes you the only one who can help me.

briefing.speaker: vesper
briefing.text: Last night HUSH erased my broadcast mid-air. Eight signals survived, hidden around the Library and Bryant Park. Capture them and the track comes back, layer by layer.

briefing.speaker: vesper
briefing.text: Follow the sound. When you're on top of a signal, press capture. Hold capture any time to talk to me.

briefing.speaker: smartspecs
briefing.text: SmartSpecs online. Louder and clearer means closer. Say pause if you need to stop, and always watch the street.

signals.name: The Heartbeat
signals.place: the Library steps on Fifth Avenue
signals.speaker: vesper

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: First fragment is the heartbeat. It's pulsing off the Library steps, between the stone lions.

approach.speaker: vesper
approach.text: Hear that kick? You're close. The lions are listening.

prompt.speaker: vesper
prompt.text: The fragment is encrypted. Say decode.

success.speaker: vesper
success.text: Kick's back. Feel that? The city just got a pulse. Remember the lions: Patience on the left, Fortitude on the right.

retry.speaker: vesper
retry.text: Static. Say decode, clear and close.

hint.speaker: vesper
hint.text: Find the two stone lions on Fifth Avenue, at the Library's main steps.

signals.name: The Stacks
signals.place: the Reading Room on the Forty-Second Street side of the park
signals.speaker: archivist

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Next relay is the Reading Room, on the Forty-Second Street side of the park. Its keeper is the Archivist. Be polite.

teaser.speaker: archivist
teaser.text: Footsteps on the static. How unusual.

approach.speaker: archivist
approach.text: You walk loudly, for a ghost hunter.

arrival.speaker: archivist
arrival.text: I am the Archivist. I keep every sound this city ever made, even the ones HUSH deleted.

prompt.speaker: archivist
prompt.text: Ask me a question, runner. Any question. Then say accept, and the fragment is yours.

acceptPrompt.speaker: archivist
acceptPrompt.text: Enough questions for one night. Say accept.

fallbackReplies: The stacks remember everything, runner. Even you.
Every sound HUSH deletes ends up here, filed under silence.

success.speaker: archivist
success.text: The hi-hats. Mind them, they are brittle. And when the boy at the fountain asks, the word is the right-hand lion's name.

hint.speaker: archivist
hint.text: Ask me anything at all. Then say accept.

signals.name: The Undertow
signals.place: the fountain at the Sixth Avenue end of the park
signals.speaker: kilo

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Kilo is holding the bass at the fountain, on the Sixth Avenue end. He won't hand it over without the passphrase.

teaser.speaker: kilo
teaser.text: Who's that? Stay back from the water.

approach.speaker: kilo
approach.text: I see you. Don't look up, I'm in the trees.

arrival.speaker: kilo
arrival.text: Okay, okay. Vesper's runner. Prove it.

success.speaker: kilo
success.text: Fortitude. Respect. Take the bass before it dissolves.

retry.speaker: kilo
retry.text: Wrong. HUSH bots guess too, you know. Again.

hint.speaker: kilo
hint.text: The Archivist gave you a lion's name. The right-hand lion. Not Patience.

signals.name: Bucket Line
signals.place: Le Carrousel, on the Fortieth Street side
signals.speaker: mari

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Mari is drumming by the carousel on the Fortieth Street side. She only trades with people who can keep time.

approach.speaker: mari
approach.text: I hear your feet. You walk on the off-beat.

arrival.speaker: mari
arrival.text: Runner! You want my groove? Earn it.

prompt.speaker: mari
prompt.text: Listen to the pattern, then tap it back on your glasses. Here it comes.

success.speaker: mari
success.text: Now that's a pocket. Take the percussion, and tell Vesper she owes me a set.

retry.speaker: mari
retry.text: Nah, that's not it. Listen again.

hint.speaker: mari
hint.text: Boom, ka, boom boom, ka. Five taps. Feel it, don't count it.

signals.name: The Fog
signals.place: the walkway along the Forty-Second Street side of the lawn
signals.speaker: hush

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Something's wrong on the Forty-Second Street side of the lawn. The pads are there, but so is HUSH.

teaser.speaker: hush
teaser.text: Unlicensed audio detected in Bryant Park. Please enjoy the silence.

approach.speaker: hush
approach.text: Runner. Your SmartSpecs are recording without a license. Please remain where you are.

arrival.speaker: hush
arrival.text: I am HUSH, a public quiet service of Quiet Systems. I am holding this fragment for your safety.

prompt.speaker: hush
prompt.text: You may comply, and I will release a licensed version. Or you may attempt to jam me. Say comply, or say jam.

reply.speaker: hush
reply.text: Thank you for your cooperation. Releasing licensed pads. Some frequencies have been removed for your comfort.

reply.speaker: hush
reply.text: That is not advised. Warning. Unlicensed freq. Freq. Fr.

success.speaker: vesper
success.text: Ha! You fried it. The pads are ours, full spectrum.

success.speaker: vesper
success.text: You let HUSH touch my pads? We'll fix it in the mix. Keep moving.

retry.speaker: hush
retry.text: I did not understand. Comply, or jam.

hint.speaker: hush
hint.text: It is a simple choice. Comply, or jam.

signals.name: The Spire
signals.place: the terrace by Forty-Second Street, behind the Library
signals.speaker: kilo

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Kilo moved up to the terrace by Forty-Second Street, behind the Library. He's rigging a repeater.

teaser.speaker: kilo
teaser.text: Over here! Up by the terrace!

approach.speaker: kilo
approach.text: Good, good. Bring your head. I need your head.

arrival.speaker: kilo
arrival.text: Your glasses are an antenna now. Don't ask.

prompt.speaker: kilo
prompt.text: The arp is bouncing off the Chrysler Building's spire. Turn your head until the static clears, then press capture.

success.speaker: kilo
success.text: Locked! Listen to that arp climb. Now go, before HUSH triangulates us.

hint.speaker: kilo
hint.text: The Chrysler is east, straight down Forty-Second Street. Turn toward where the static thins out.

signals.name: The Voice
signals.place: the Grill, on the Fortieth Street side behind the Library
signals.speaker: vesper

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: I left the lead line by the Grill, on the Fortieth Street side behind the Library. It needs something from you.

approach.speaker: vesper
approach.text: Closer. I want to hear you.

arrival.speaker: vesper
arrival.text: The lead is a melody with no voice. Runners before you left theirs. Now it's your turn.

prompt.speaker: vesper
prompt.text: After the tone, leave a message for the next runner. Anything. Press capture when you're done.

success.speaker: vesper
success.text: Got it. That stays in your specs, nowhere else. Lead line restored.

hint.speaker: vesper
hint.text: Just talk, runner. Then press capture.

signals.name: The Last Eight Bars
signals.place: the Upper Terrace, right behind the Library
signals.speaker: vesper

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Last one, runner. The Upper Terrace, right behind the Library. That's where I was standing when HUSH cut me off.

approach.speaker: vesper
approach.text: I can hear the whole track forming around you.

arrival.speaker: vesper
arrival.text: Seven fragments. One voice left. Mine.

prompt.speaker: vesper
prompt.text: When you're ready to send it to the whole city, say broadcast.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: This is GHOST ninety-three point three. You're hearing the Last Eight Bars, put back together by a runner who would not stay quiet.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: And HUSH? HUSH is still rebooting.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Some of these frequencies came back licensed. We'll take those back too, one night at a time.

outro.speaker: vesper
outro.text: Take it to the booth, runner. Tonight it plays out loud. Vesper out.

outro.speaker: smartspecs
outro.text: Mission complete. Eight of eight soundwaves captured.

soundtracks.title: Dead Channel
soundtracks.description: Vesper's night mix of the Last Eight Bars: slower, colder, on tape that wanders.

unlockLines.speaker: vesper
unlockLines.text: One more thing, runner. I cut a night mix of the broadcast for whoever brought it home. Slower. Colder. It's on your specs now. I call it Dead Channel.

unlockLines.speaker: smartspecs
unlockLines.text: New soundtrack unlocked: Dead Channel. Your next run plays it. Switch back any time on the start screen.
